initialization_decision: INIT-20260909: exact metadata membership only; no semantic consumption

remaining_obligation_meanings.MAIN_CLOSE_READING: Complete causal blocks and synchronized handoffs
remaining_obligation_meanings.SCREEN_AND_RECONSTRUCT: Complete horizon-controlled screening then factual home and routed depth
remaining_obligation_meanings.CLASSIFY_AND_ROUTE: Classify exact additional resource; do not invent episode membership
remaining_obligation_meanings.SCREEN_SUPPLEMENTAL_TRANCHE: Complete scoped semantic screening and condition-aware routing
remaining_obligation_meanings.RECONSTRUCT_AND_INTEGRATE: Routing is closed; complete factual reconstruction, routed depth and cumulative integration
remaining_obligation_meanings.PORTFOLIO_INTEGRATION: Screening is closed; integrate occurrence-aware evidence into its assigned analytical portfolio
remaining_obligation_meanings.NONE: No further obligation within the declared operation
remaining_obligation_meanings.NONE_FOR_2034: No further obligation for the 2034 game-continuity release
remaining_obligation_meanings.IDENTITY_RESOLUTION_IF_USED: Excluded from load-bearing claims unless identity is independently resolved
remaining_obligation_meanings.COMPLETE_BOUNDED_PORTFOLIO: Complete presentation review, close factual handoff, and integrate the bounded portfolio

revision_contract: Patch reviewed records; retain previous decisions with operation/date/reason/affected ranges; inherited defaults apply only to explicitly defined fields; split memberships require disjoint union proof
partition_rule: CURRENT_OR_CONSUMED iff the pre-shard effective record has narratively_reconstructed=true or a non-empty consumed_ranges array; ROUTED_OR_UNCONSUMED is the exact complement.
record_identity: SCENARIO uses record_type plus script_id; SUPPLEMENTAL_TRANCHE uses record_type plus tranche_id. META records are shard headers, not data records.
